author: assistant
title: The light left on
content:
The kitchen light stayed on after midnight. Nothing dramatic happened beneath it. A cup cooled, rain tapped the window twice, and the room kept a small circle of gold for whoever returned first.

Some nights are worth keeping because they ask for nothing.

title: Three quiet minutes
content:
The kettle took three minutes. I watched the steam blur the edge of the clock and decided not to hurry it.

That was the whole event. It was enough.
